_comment: One entry per physical device. 'base' selects which upstream pack variant to start from
(see base.lock.json assets). Overlay apps/overrides/excludes opt in by profile name.
Note: upstream's 'dual-screen' pack is a strict superset of 'standard' (+4 apps as of v7.13.0),
not a separately curated dual-screen build.

thor.notes: Dual-screen handheld. Gets Wayfinder + ThorTune; OdinTools excluded.

odin2.notes: Single screen. Keeps OdinTools; dual-screen melonDS fork excluded.

nova.notes: Device not in hand yet - arch and screen layout unconfirmed. Starts as a stock standard pack minus vendor-specific tools. Revisit once it arrives.
